baseline.description: Five flight-group folds. Global -> airport -> record quality -> runway -> stand -> stand/runway partial pooling of residual q20, mean and IQR. Every fitting label retained. Fit rows receive out-of-fold features; October/score/ranking use a full-fitting map.

configuration.context: New development campaign authorized by continue after historical-methods research. Prior Phase-5 tuning is frozen. These reused development sets are not an independent audit.
configuration.global_candidate: 50% new global model plus 50% frozen original-seed Phase-4 airport models, matching the Phase-5 global_capacity structure.
configuration.refit_iterations: Rounded median of the two October-selected counts for the selected new model. Retain frozen prior-model refits for the old components.
configuration.selection: Evaluate the 20 declared candidate/v4 weights. Require at least 0.5% lower complete-set RMSE on BOTH folds than v4; minimize equally weighted mean RMSE ratio. No airport-specific or fold-specific blend weights.
configuration.specialist_candidate: Replace only missing-NM predictions with a new all-airport missing-record expert; other rows retain v4 exactly.
configuration.target_loss: For scaled residual z=(y-offset-baseline)/scale, sample weight=(scale/600)^2. Thus weighted squared error is original squared-seconds error divided by a common 600^2. October early stopping explicitly uses unweighted RMSE in seconds.

rule: Evaluate the 20 declared candidate/v4 weights. Require at least 0.5% lower complete-set RMSE on BOTH folds than v4; minimize equally weighted mean RMSE ratio. No airport-specific or fold-specific blend weights.
